prs.location: The Clauin Glasan homes are conveniently located in Kilkenny City they have the benefit of all the amenities offered by the city.  The development is also close to excellent transport links, schools, hospital, medical centre, hotels, shopping and recreational facilities.
prs.aboutDevelopment: Clúid Housing is proud to offer not-for-profit cost rental housing to the public. This new rental option is supported by the Department of Housing, Local Government and Heritage. Cost rental is not-for-profit housing. Your rent covers the cost of the construction, management, and maintenance of your new home. Cost rental offers you a long-term, secure tenancy that is more affordable. We've managed to achieve rents that start at 25% below the average local area rent. Cost rental is a long-term rental option.

description:
This three bedroom house located in Cluain Glasan, Granges Road, Kilkenny.

The A-rated energy efficient property is semi-furnished, allowing the tenant to furnish their home to their own taste. The home includes white goods, including a fridge freezer, a dishwasher, an oven and hob, a microwave, and washer dryer as standard. Roller blinds are supplied,  including blackout blinds in bedrooms, in addition to wood effect vinyl flooring downstairs, there is carpet on the stairs and in the bedrooms and tiled bathrooms.
